342		// Configure TLS

344		if err != nil {

346		}

350		}

352		// Create the logger

354	
355		// Validate enterprise license before anything stateful happens

357			return nil, err
358		}
359	
360		// Create the server
361		s := &Server{
362			config:                  config,
363			consulCatalog:           consulCatalog,
364			connPool:                pool.NewPool(logger, serverRPCCache, serverMaxStreams, tlsWrap, config.RPCSessionConfig, config.RPCDialTimeout),
365			logger:                  logger,
366			tlsWrap:                 tlsWrap,
367			rpcServer:               rpc.NewServer(),
368			streamingRpcs:           structs.NewStreamingRpcRegistry(),
369			nodeConns:               make(map[string][]*nodeConnState),
370			peersCache:              peers.NewPeerCache(config.Region),
371			bootstrapped:            &atomic.Bool{},
372			reassertLeaderCh:        make(chan chan error),
373			reconcileCh:             make(chan serf.Member, 32),
374			readyForConsistentReads: &atomic.Bool{},
375			eventCh:                 make(chan serf.Event, 256),
376			reapCancelableEvalsCh:   make(chan struct{}),
377			rpcTLS:                  incomingTLS,
378			workersEventCh:          make(chan interface{}, 1),
379			lockTTLTimer:            lock.NewTTLTimer(),
380			lockDelayTimer:          lock.NewDelayTimer(),
381		}
382	
383		s.shutdownCtx, s.shutdownCancel = context.WithCancel(context.Background())
384		s.shutdownCh = s.shutdownCtx.Done()
385	
386		// Generate a timeout context for the server process which we wait for and
387		// can time out on.
388		startupTimeout, startupCancel := context.WithTimeout(s.shutdownCtx, s.config.StartTimeout)
389		defer startupCancel()
390	
391		// Create an eval broker
392		evalBroker, err := NewEvalBroker(

394			config.EvalNackTimeout,
395			config.EvalNackInitialReenqueueDelay,
396			config.EvalNackSubsequentReenqueueDelay,
397			config.EvalDeliveryLimit)

399			return nil, err
400		}
401		s.evalBroker = evalBroker
402	
403		// Create the blocked evals

405	
406		// Create the RPC handler

408	
409		// Create the planner

418

421

423		s.statsFetcher = NewStatsFetcher(s.logger, s.connPool, s.config.Region)
424		s.statsFetcher.SetLocalServer(s)
425	
426		// Setup Consul

428	
429		// Set up the keyring

435			}
